🛣 Road to the lot at row 4, column 3

No road reaches this lot, so "Private cottage" cannot be built on it. Here is what you can do:

🌉 Reaching this lot takes 2 lots of road and a crossing over water (1 lots of culvert or footbridge). Whole road: 160 SUP. The road stays public for good.

🛣 No road reaches this lot yet. 2 lots of road are laid, 1 of them on your own lots, for 20 SUP.

If you do not want a road, the sale is cancelled, 400 SUP comes back to you from the city treasury and the lot returns to the city.

💵 Lot price: 400 SUP (between 100 SUP and 5,000 SUP)

🏡 Become a resident of Korendal?

Your home moves to this city. Your properties, companies and job stay where they are, but from now on your income tax goes to the city treasury and you need a work permit to work in other cities.
You cannot move home again for 72h.
